mission_set: Source-based research supporting mission planning and PIR answers.
Evidence production that keeps direct evidence separate from LLM interpretation.

essential_tasks.task_statement: Rate source reliability for every planned source before it is cited as evidence.
conditions: Given a source-plan annex with planned sources and expected claims.
Given access to the source reliability rubric grades A through D.
standards: 100 percent of cited sources carry an A/B/C/D tier with a stated rationale.
Zero tier-X sources appear in a final output.
Recency uncertainty is flagged on every source older than its stability window.
evaluation_evidence: AAR ARU-AAR-20260618-001 classified source rating as sustain.
Source map lint passed on the last three missions.

essential_tasks.task_statement: Separate claim, inference, and open question in every research product.
conditions: Given a PIR and a set of collected sources of mixed reliability.
standards: Every claim links to at least one graded source.
Every inference is labeled as LLM interpretation.
Open questions are listed explicitly instead of being filled by guesses.
evaluation_evidence: Three consecutive research products passed Red Team review with no unsupported claims.
